name: streetkode-storefront
description: Street dance streetwear storefront. Speaks A2A 0.3 JSON-RPC, exposes the live catalog as typed offers, and settles orders in USDC on Circle's Arc Testnet over an a2a-x402 payment challenge. Also publishes a UCP discovery profile and AP2 cart/payment mandates.

skills.name: Browse catalog
skills.description: Return every purchasable SKU as a typed offer: title, sizes, availability, price and the stablecoins accepted.

skills.name: A2A message/send
skills.description: JSON-RPC endpoint for agent negotiation. Returns AP2 CartMandate + a2a-x402 payment-required on turn 1, and a PaymentMandate receipt on turn 2.

skills.name: UCP discovery
skills.description: Universal Commerce Protocol discovery profile for the Arc Testnet USDC payment handler.

skills.name: AP2 mandate
skills.description: Generate an AP2 CartMandate + PaymentMandate + x402 requirement for a given SKU.

skills.name: Purchase
skills.description: Re-send the order with an X-PAYMENT header carrying the Arc transaction hash. The server verifies the transfer on-chain before releasing the fulfilment object.

rights.description: DanceMoveTokens — the move-rights registry. An offer's provenance pointer resolves to a log() event naming the choreographer and the IPFS rights CID.
